name: star_quality_v1
layer: interim analysis layer on top of the frozen exosearch v1.0.0 search (search code and config_hash 80ffc7f29943 unchanged)
registered: 2026-11-10, after unblinding: committed after partial inverted-null statistics and the top-25 null peaks had been seen (see disclosure), but before the cut was evaluated on any population. Frozen: threshold and definition will not change for v1.0.0/interim results; sensitivity to beta_max 2.5/3/4/none is reported alongside.
beta_max: max over the 8 trial durations D (0.04-0.25 d) of beta_D = CDPP_D * sqrt(D / cadence) / sigma_w
measured_on: the star's own quality-masked PDCSAP light curve (no injection, no inversion), after the frozen v1.0.0 detrend (wotan biweight 0.75 d, gap trim 0.3 d, upward 4-sigma clip); exosearch.bls.noise_profile
rationale: S assumes the noise at transit timescales is characterised by CDPP_D. beta_D > 3 means the noise on 1-6 h is more than 3x the white-noise extrapolation, i.e. strongly correlated residuals (variability the 0.75 d biweight did not remove) where the box statistic is not calibrated without GP prewhitening. One threshold, chosen on physical grounds.
disclosure: Before registering this cut we had seen summary statistics of the partial inverted null (quantiles of max S, beta_D quantiles of the peaks, and the 25 highest-S null peaks, which are mostly single-epoch events on faint stars). We did not evaluate any candidate cut against the null before this file was committed.
sensitivity_reported: products/v1.0.0/analysis_layer/review/review.json: quality_sensitivity (S* and vetted completeness at beta_max 2.5, 3, 4, no cut) and toi_dropped_vs_kept
